title: Hold Still A Moment
style: Intimate synthpop with a measured, swaying midtempo pulse; glassy analog arpeggios and soft drum-machine ticks under warm rounded bass. Open with close, breath-near female vocals and a few isolated keys, then widen into a gently lifting chorus with layered harmonies, glossy pads, and crisp restrained percussion. Keep the verses confessional and detailed, the chorus affectionate and memorable; polished studio mix with clear vocal intimacy and a soft-focus, photographic finish.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You stand beside that bear like it’s an old friend
Arms folded, half a smile you try to hide
Blue paper sky behind your teal-cut hair
A little gold-green spark pinned at your side

[Pre-Chorus]
I notice every freckle when you turn
The tiny mark that makes your cheek your own
You look away, then catch me looking back
And suddenly this room feels less like stone

[Chorus]
Hold still a moment, let me keep this view
Your hazel eyes, the way they soften blue
I could stay here, learning every line
As if your face were something made for mine
No pose, no perfect angle, nothing planned
Just you, and my heart forgetting where it stands

[Verse 2]
Boots planted easy, denim torn at the knee
Peach on your lips, green shade brushed above
You laugh, and all the careful light gives way
I came to study pictures; now I study love

[Pre-Chorus]
The room goes quiet when you meet my eyes
You tilt your chin; the whole world seems to lean
I keep the details no one else would frame
The candid pause between what might have been

[Chorus]
Hold still a moment, let me keep this view
Your hazel eyes, the way they soften blue
I could stay here, learning every line
As if your face were something made for mine
No pose, no perfect angle, nothing planned
Just you, and my heart forgetting where it stands

[Bridge]
If every photograph could learn to breathe
It still could never hold the way you look at me
So let the picture blur around the edges
I want the living moment, not the image

[Final Chorus]
Hold still a moment, let me keep this view
Your hazel eyes, the way they soften blue
I could stay here, learning every line
As if your face were something made for mine
No pose, no perfect angle, nothing planned
Just you, and my heart forgetting where it stands

[Outro]
Stay just as you are
I’ll remember this
